front.title: Veriflow Evidence Envelope for Source-Grounded Computational Claims

abstract.t: This document specifies an experimental, JSON-based evidence envelope for exchanging source-grounded computational assertions, including provenance, reproducible operation identifiers, evidence sufficiency, and explicit abstention when an answer is not supported. The envelope separates syntactic validity, source integrity, mathematical correctness, and empirical truth. This document does not standardize a general scientific inference engine or claim experimental superiority.
